st: Our Horrifying Experience in the Clown Tunnel
d: Sam and Colby explore the haunted Clown Tunnel, where there were reported scary clown sightings at night.

st: The Handyman; Anatole; Makeup Magic; Screwdriver; Charlie
d: A man receives a shock when he tries to rob his wife's coffin; two burglars are startled when they encounter a long-dead movie legend.

st: The Dealer; Gratuity; The Cake; 1st Time Offender; The Mirror of Truth
d: A woman bestows the gift of life on her beloved; a beautiful woman struggles to cast off an evil curse.

Jan and Dale Foster's 6-year-old son, Cody, starts talking to an imaginary playmate; soon, Cody's behavior becomes erratic and Jan wonders if there is a connection between his outbursts and his imaginary friend.
A newlywed couple moves into their first home where the ghost of a young girl named Sallie warns them of an evil spirit lurking in the shadows.

An American family moves into a mansion in rural Taiwan; soon, they begin to see spectral lights, hear strange footsteps and feel as if they're being stalked; a Taoist priest tells them the house is plagued with ghosts who terrorize the living.
In Connecticut, a 12-year-old boy bears the brunt of a demon's wrath and becomes possessed.
When a single mother finds a photograph of a soldier killed in the Vietnam War, she comes to believe he is haunting her home; she calls a psychic after her two young daughters report seeing him too.

A Maryland family is terrorized by a houseful of ghosts, whose late-night attacks slowly drive them apart; only a young boy is able to challenge the violent entities; years later, he tells the tale on a local radio show.
A wolf-man stalks its prey on a dark country road; a man comes face to face with the bloodthirsty Michigan Dogman; the ravenous Wendigo transforms men into cannibals.

st: Evil Gnomes; Bigfoot Wars; Hell Hounds
d: A family in Porterville, Calif., stalked by evil gnomes; Sasquatch warring with each other; hellhounds in Palm Springs, Fla.

d: A hunter attacked by the Skunk Ape; evidence of the Lizard Man; a teenage boy describes his alien abduction.
A family's lives are at stake while they try to battle an evil entity sent to tear a young couple apart.
When three siblings communicate with the family ghost using a spirit board, they have no idea they've opened the door for good and evil spirits.
Jeanette buys a fixer-upper home in a rural enclave, but renovations reveal evidence of evil doings and a restless evil.
After visiting a haunted plantation, a woman and her daughters encounter a phantom that is tied to her past.
When their daughter hears a voice in her head and begins acting strangely, the Balistreris search for the cause.

The Flying Humanoid creeps the Missouri Ozarks; the Batsquatch flies over the Rio Grande; the Jersey Devil is on the hunt in Pine Barrens.
